reasons: Applies a literal 100 scale in promql; the units differ (Datadog iowait is a percent, the OTel cpu.time rate is a seconds-per-second ratio), so the scale must go in notes with a documentation link, not in promql.
Uses a fixed [5m] range instead of [$__rate_interval], which the converter rules forbid.

Otherwise the quantity (CPU wait fraction per host, then max across hosts) and the monotonic sum rate look compatible; cpu_mode is an observed dataset label, but host_name is not listed in dataset_labels and needs confirmation against the dataset (possibly host_name vs a newer label name).
Outcome 'translated' is not justified while the scale and window rules are violated; the request should be re-derived under the rules.
